lastCompletedStory.title: Repoint worker call sites to per-phase backend

nextStoryContext: US-002 repointed the implementer (loop.ts:1014), reviewer (review.ts:338), planner (plan-runner.ts:595) and auditor (plan-runner.ts:632) call sites from readBackend() to readPhaseBackend('<phase>'), each a one-line swap reusing the Phase literal already passed to the adjacent readPhaseModel call. run.ts's orchestrator call site (run.ts:425) was deliberately left on readBackend() per this story's own AC4 -- the orchestrator's backend is not phase-scoped this slice. src/logging/spawn-resolution.ts (CODEX_GUARD_NOTICE) needed no change: it already took whatever backend string its caller resolved, so it now fires per-phase automatically. src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts (BackendAdapter/ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv) is still untouched by both US-001 and US-002 -- if a future story in this PRD wires actual per-backend spawn-argv behavior (e.g. codex support), that seam is where it lands.
